name: Runefocus Rod
description: A crystal-inlaid channeling rod tuned to stabilize short arcane workings.
narrative_effects: Provides narrative grounding for controlled casting in unstable magical environments.

mechanical_effect.trigger: held and used to channel a short arcane working in an unstable magical environment
mechanical_effect.applies_to: controlled casting, stabilization, or theory-grounded checks where the rod provides narrative grounding in unstable magical conditions
mechanical_effect.does_not_apply: mundane tasks; long rituals beyond a short working; environments that are stable enough that the rod provides no special help
